decisions.evidence_text:

Kumar Ritesh: Isolate inventory from checkout latency. Choice: Reserve stock through an asynchronous command with a visible pending state. Rationale: A bounded asynchronous boundary prevents one dependency from stalling checkout. Outcome: Synthetic checkout p95 improved from 4.1 seconds to 1.2 seconds.
decisions.page_or_segment: section at 2026-09-14 09:21 — Kumar Ritesh (Senior Software Engineer)
decisions.choice: Reserve stock through an asynchronous command with a visible pending state
alternatives: Call inventory synchronously in the checkout request
rationale: A bounded asynchronous boundary prevents one dependency from stalling checkout
constraints: Reservation response target is two seconds
risks: Customers may briefly see a pending order
decisions.outcome: Synthetic checkout p95 improved from 4.1 seconds to 1.2 seconds.
